§ 01

About — a buyer-side desk in India

Independent. Not a factory, not a manufacturer — a sourcing and procurement partner working on your side of the table.

FILE NOTES ROLE — BUYER-SIDE PARTNER
BASE — INDIA
CONTACT — FOUNDER, DIRECT
CATALOGUE — NONE FIXED;
WORK FOLLOWS YOUR BRIEF

SRS Global Sourcing is an independent sourcing and procurement partner based in India. We do not own factories and we do not manufacture products. Our role is to help international businesses find the right Indian manufacturers and suppliers for what they need — and to coordinate the sourcing process professionally, from first inquiry to order.

Buying from another country involves more than finding a name online. Specifications, pricing, samples and timelines all have to line up across distance, language and time zones. We exist to make that process clearer and more manageable — with careful supplier identification, structured communication, and honest coordination at every step.

Every inquiry is handled personally by our founder, so you always know who you are speaking with and who is responsible for your requirement.

Make sourcing from India straightforward and dependable

Our mission is to give international buyers a reliable, professional point of contact in India — one that understands their requirements, identifies suitable suppliers with care, and communicates clearly and transparently throughout the sourcing process.

Understand first

We start with your product, specifications, quantities and target market — before we approach any supplier.

Communicate clearly

Identify Suitable Suppliers

Coordinate Quotations and Samples

We assist with communication, quotations, product specifications, and sample coordination where available — keeping you updated as responses come in.

Stage IV — SupportIV

Support Procurement Coordination

We help coordinate communication and sourcing activities according to the agreed scope of work — through to completion.

This dashboard needs two values from your own Supabase project — the Project URL and the anon / publishable key — pasted into the SRS_SUPABASE config block at the top of this page's script, and the SQL setup below run once in the Supabase SQL Editor. Until then, no inquiries can be saved or shown here, and no sample data is displayed.

No inquiries yet. New website inquiries saved to Supabase will appear here, newest first.
Supabase setup — SQL to run once (click to expand) 
create table public.inquiries (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  full_name text not null,
  company text,
  business_email text not null,
  country text,
  product_category text,
  product_requirements text,
  estimated_quantity text,
  message text,
  status text not null default 'New',
  source text default 'website'
);

alter table public.inquiries enable row level security;

-- Visitors (anon key) may INSERT only — they cannot read any inquiry.
create policy "Allow anonymous insert"
  on public.inquiries for insert
  to anon
  with check (true);

-- Only the signed-in owner account may read inquiries.
create policy "Owner can read inquiries"
  on public.inquiries for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

-- Only the signed-in owner account may update inquiries.
create policy "Owner can update inquiries"
  on public.inquiries for update
  to authenticated
  using (true)
  with check (true);

Steps: 1) Create a free project at supabase.com. 2) SQL Editor → run the SQL above. 3) Authentication → Users → add your admin user (email + password). 4) Project Settings → API → copy Project URL + anon/publishable key into the SRS_SUPABASE config in this page. 5) Submit a real test inquiry from the website and check it appears here before calling the form live.
